title: Page 117
transc:
Bermuda Landing May 10th 1864
Maj Eckert Di  6.30 A. m.
in the field near Bermuda landing may poney for Bruno
zodiac our operations may be summed up in a few
words with glory prolong pacific we have advanced up the
penin sula forced the chicka hominy and have safely brought
them to our present position zebra these were colored cavalry
and are now holding our advanced pickets towards Galway Gen'l
Kautz with perfume purple pacific from Genoa on the same
day with our movement up the Bergen forced the black
water burnt the welch bridge at Stoney Creek below Gideon
Cutting in two Hollands force at that point Ind is
now operating against Hickford and Harvey zodiac we have landed
here Rodneyd ourselves destroyed many miles of welch and got
a position which with proper supplies we can hold out
against the whole of Hunters opal I have ordered up
the supplies zodiac Holland with a large portion of his
command was left south by the cutting of the welch
by Kautz that portion which reached Gabriel under history I
have whipped today Killing and wounding many and taking many
prisoners after a severe and well contested fight zebra John
will not be troubled with any further webb to Hunter
from Honduras salems signed Knox all well down this way
R O Brien
